description: Changes a standard mate in place, in the active configuration: a distance mate's distance_mm, an angle mate's angle_deg, the alignment, the flip, or whether it is suppressed. Give at least one. Checked by measuring as mate.add is (a suppressed mate imposes nothing, so only its state is checked); otherwise the old values are put back, and so is every component the solve moved. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The assembly: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

mate.description: The mate: its reference (r1.mate.…) or its name (Distance1).

distance_mm.description: A distance mate's new distance, mm, 0 or more.

angle_deg.description: An angle mate's new angle, degrees, 0 to 180.

alignment.description: aligned, anti_aligned or closest. Not for lock or perpendicular.

flip.description: For distance and angle mates: the value on the other side (true) or not (false).

suppressed.description: Suppress (true) or unsuppress (false) the mate in the active configuration.
